sentences.en: The playground is divided into three areas by white lines.
sentences.zh: 白线将操场分成了三个区域。

sentences.en: It is wrong to divide language into "living" and "dead".
sentences.zh: 把语言分为‘活的语言’和‘死的语言’是不对的。

sentences.en: Oceans do not so much divide the world as unite it.
sentences.zh: 海洋并没有分割世界，反而将其连接在一起。

senses.zh: 划分；除；分开；使产生分歧
